note: Dense numeric coefficient table (Table 25.3, Lagrangian Integration Coefficients, n=3,5,7,9 odd and n=4,6,8,10 even). Digit-perfect transcription for n=3,4,5,6,7 (3-5 digit coefficients); n=9,8,10 have 6-8 digit coefficients and were left structural (shape + D only), the higher misread risk not being worth it for gold data. Every transcribed row verified: its coefficients sum exactly to its own D (a real property of Lagrangian weights, not a coincidence) -- checked with a Python script before committing; all 11 transcribed rows (n=3,4,5,6,7) passed.
